steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Wow! So this is where they audition for the leading actress?
As agreed, you have come to the audition with Luvia according to the address on the invitation, pretending to be her agent.
After the attack, the organization still hasn't given up, which shows how arrogant these frauds are... They must have a strong backup.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Thank you for coming to the audition with me. I feel much more confident now.
Standing before the building, Luvia smiles at you.

options: You're welcome. How's prepping for the audition?

choices.text: You're welcome. How's prepping for the audition?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: This audition is kind of special. I couldn't prepare for it.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Normally, they give actors a script before the audition, but this crew wants to test my ability to improvise, so I couldn't prepare in advance...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: But I believe in myself!
As soon as you enter the building, two men with sunglasses stop you from looking around, and lead you the way.
The whole building is surprisingly quiet. Unlike the bustling crews featured on the news, it seems very mysterious.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: S-So professional... So this is what a well-known director's crew is like... They even have a waiting room...
You are led to a tiny room with only one tiny window. The walls are patchy with messy paint, as if they are covering something up.
Something's obviously wrong here, but Luvia doesn't seem to notice at all. No wonder Ray is worried about her.

options: Did you use to go to auditions by yourself?

choices.text: Did you use to go to auditions by yourself?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Of course not. Ray would always come with me.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Even though she doesn't like me acting, we share the same body, so she has no choice but to come with me.
Since Ray is mentioned, Luvia's hands stop rubbing the corner of her coat nervously, even though she sounds slightly disgruntled.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: She never wanted me to become an actress or enter the entertainment industry.
But it seems like she didn't stop you?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: She did actually... Back then I didn't realize Ray's presence, I mean, who would ever think that there's someone else inside you?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: But then strange things happened to me more and more frequently, like losing my consciousness when I'm back home after shooting, or the producer covering his head and cursing at me when I'm back from a daze.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: The scripts I received would somehow end up in the shredder, and the makeup products I bought for auditions would end up in the trash can.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I thought there were ghosts at first. I was so scared... I only found out later that there was another soul living in my body, who caused all these troubles.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: She refused to say.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: She couldn't talk to me in my head at first and we had to communicate with pen and paper. I would write what I wanted to say in my journal and put it in front of me, then she would write her reply after she woke up. So I haven't had much of a real conversation with Ray.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: But I've been in great spirits recently, particularly during filmings. And I accidentally got hit by some props on the head the other day, but I turned out completely fine...!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Then I found that I could talk to Ray in my mind! But... we fight all the time... We can't even have a proper chat...

Luvia's words make you frown. A Sinner being unusually excited, with body recovering at astonishing speed, and even able to communicate with another personality in her mind... These are clear signs of Mania worsening.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: But it's okay! If I get to be the leading actress in this audition, Ray will definitely be super impressed!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Then even Ray will think highly of me!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: And then I'll tell her, see? I can be an actress! It's my dream, and I'll definitely succeed!
Perhaps it's because you are one of the few people who know about Ray's existence, Luvia can't stop telling you about her hopes and dreams for this audition.
Sadly, everything seems to suggest that this dream will eventually be crushed.

steps.speaker: Camera Assistant
steps.content: Luvia? Is Luvia here?!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Yes! H-here! I-Is the audition... s-starting?
The man's gaze roves over Luvia before gesturing for her to follow with a nod.
The audition room is extremely rudimentary, which is the opposite of that exquisite audition invitation's style. A long table with a few chairs is all there is.

Behind the table, a few men size you two up. The man in the middle wears an out-of-fashion tasseled shirt and a pair of flamboyant sunglasses, with his unkempt hair tied behind his head. A sign in front of him writes—Director.
Either nervous or intimidated, Luvia's body stiffens as soon as she sees the men.

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: So you're Luvia? And this person with you is...?
I'm her agent.

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: You have an agent with you? Tsk... What a pain.
steps.female_content: You have an agent? ...Tsk. Never mind. It's even better.

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: Let's get started then. Let's see you being scared.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Okay!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ah! I'm so scared! Ah! Stay away from me! Ah!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ahhh!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ahhh!
A dramatic look shows on Luvia's face. She waves her hand in front of her eyes, doing her best to look terrified.

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: That's not great...

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: Try crying. As miserable as you can.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Waah... I'm so miserable...
At hearing the request, Luvia covers her eyes with her hand, pacing small steps and wiping the imaginary tears.
Hmm...
After seeing her performance, you do understand why Ray said Luvia wasn't fit for acting.

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: Whatever. At least you have a pretty face.

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: Go wait in the lounge!
The two men next to the director shoot each other a glance, then they stand up and shove you two out.
These two stout men keep darting their gazes at Luvia. You two walk between them on the way, who are more like escorting you than leading the way.
steps.female_content: These two stout men keep darting their gazes at you two. You two walk between them on the way, who are more like escorting you than leading the way.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Chi... Sir, this audition seems very strange. It's an audition for the leading actress, but how come it looks like I'm the only auditionee? Can it be that... they think I'm the only suitable one?
steps.female_content: Chi... Miss, this audition seems very strange. It's an audition for the female lead, but how come it looks like I'm the only auditionee? Can it be that... they think I'm the only suitable actress?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: But they didn't seem to be very happy just now... Anyway, the director said at the end that I had a pretty face, which means I still have a chance, right?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Sigh. Acting scared is what I'm best at. My debut was a supporting role in a horror movie.
It's okay. Even if you fail the audition, you'll at least have the experience of auditioning for a lead role.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: You're right!
Yet, at this point, you sharply notice that you two have been taken deeper into the building, to an even more hidden place than the waiting room.

Bang!!!!!
A loud noise sound on the side door, as if struck by a heavy object.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Aaah! Wh-Wh-What's going on?!

Luvia grabs your arm in fear. The two men leading the way stop and reveal their true color. Before you can pull out your gun in time, they quickly lunge at you—Pain washes over you. Your mind becomes increasingly fuzzy...
Lu... Luvia... Ray...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Who... Who's calling me...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: ...I'm okay.
When you see Luvia come to her senses, you are finally relieved and begin to survey the room.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: They tied our hands... And with a rubber cord...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: So these guys do know it's me...
You two are locked into a small room with hands tightly tied. They probably think you aren't strong enough to fight, so they put you two in the same room. You sigh—Looks like they underestimated you.
steps.female_content: You two are locked into a small room with hands tightly tied. They probably think you make a decent "prey" too, so they put you two in the same room. You sigh—Looks like they underestimated you.

steps.content: This place is just like the waiting room—a cramped space with a tiny window. Yet this small room is stuffed full of props.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: They are declaring war on me... A bunch of filthy, nasty old guys...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: They're taking advantage of this silly girl being gullible. When I get out, I'm gonna electrocute y'all until none of your bones are left...
The young girl gives you a look of contempt and sneers.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I don't think Luvia will wake up anytime soon. She's terrified. I told her so, but this silly girl, she didn't listen.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: She has been tricked so many times. How is she going to survive in the entertainment industry like this?
Some electric light flashes on Ray's fingertips, but the electricity cannot snap the non-conducting cord.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Darn it...
Give me your hand. Let me bite off your cord first. Nightingale should have received my signal by now and will get here soon. You rush out to meet her first. I'll cover you.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Huh? You can't even get your gun. How are you going to cover me?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I'm not going to dash out on my own.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: You got beaten up to protect Luvia. She will never be able to repay you. Let me repay it for her.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: So I'll have to teach these guys a good lesson.
Ray reaches her hand toward you. Luvia put effort into dressing up for this audition and is wearing perfume on her wrist. You smell the scent of rose and prune drops.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: But these guys... really know where to pick... Such a dark, confined room.
As you untie the cord, Ray takes the opportunity to survey the place.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I've been locked up in places like this before. Some places were even smaller...
Really?... Luvia never mentioned this.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: That's because only I remember it...
Ray? What's wrong...?
The cord has already been bitten loose, but you can feel Ray's hands shaking... Or more precisely, her whole body is shaking.
Ray, what's wrong? You don't look well.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Why is this here...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: This room... No... This can't be. This isn't that place.
Her breathing becomes heavier. Ray hurriedly steps back toward the window, quivering and panting, as if she is trying to escape yet is scared of some nightmare outside.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I want to leave. I need to leave now...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: It's him... It's really him... It's him!! It's him!!
You stand up and follow Ray's gaze out of the window—The person walking past is the director in the audition earlier.
It's just that he has taken off his sunglasses, revealing his face with a scar across his nose.

steps.speaker: Girl's Voice
steps.content: Please... leave me alone! I'm done doing those things!!

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: This is your only use. Shut her up!
You can't see the girl and only hear her whimper after being "shut up" and the disturbing dragging noise.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: It's really him... I'm screwed. I'm gonna die. I'm definitely gonna die...
Ray steps back as her body shivers, with her voice full of anguish and despair.
The gruesome scene seems to have provoked Ray. She paces around anxiously and suddenly slips, falling back on the props in the room.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: No... Not a bathtub. Bathtub...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Help... Help!! Please! Stop! No... Aaaah!!!
It's a broken bathtub surrounded by terrifying props. There are even red splashes in the bathtub.
Ray lets out an ear-piercing shrill. She lies in the tub and tears at her hair and clothes as if she was drowning.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I-I'll do as you say... Don't beat me. Don't drown me!!!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Aah... Ah... I'm gonna drown! I'm gonna drown! Help... Help!!!!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Stop filming! Please... Stop filming!!!
Ray struggles and wails, while her hands frantically scratch her neck as if a rope is tied around it.
Ray! Calm down! No one is going to hurt you...!
You try to go near Ray, yet Ray panics even more when she sees you.
steps.female_content: You go up to Ray to pull her up, but your hands are tied. All you can do is hold her hands, hoping this will comfort her.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: You stay away from me! So horrible... Don't...
steps.female_content: Why... Why haven't I got any energy...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: You're so scary... So scary... But I can't... I can't...
steps.female_content: Get up... I-I need to protect Luvia!

steps.content: Seeing that Ray isn't calming down, you sigh and apologize to her before you tie the shackles on her.
With the power of the shackles, you comfort Ray, who gradually calms down a little.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: No... I can't keep going like this... I have to... have to protect Luvia... I...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I'm not a pretend hero, I am Luvia's hero... I'm the hero in the mirror, her wish...
Ray...? What's wrong? I'm here. You're safe...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I... I'm going to die...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: But no... I can't... I need to protect Luvia!!!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I'm not a pretend hero... I'm the hero in the mirror. I must protect her...
Seeing that Ray isn't calming down, you sigh and apologize to her before you tie the shackles on her.
With the power of the shackles, you comfort Ray, who gradually calms down a little.
Ray is drenched in cold sweat like a rose in the morning mist. Before losing her consciousness, she mutters as she stares at the dark ceiling.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Ah... Sorry... Luvia...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Luvia, help me... Get me... out of here...
